name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Grey shapes shimmer where content will land. First paint placeholders for cards, text, and avatars.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.how: default for blocks/cards; circle for avatars; text for line stacks. Default: default.

gotchas.note: Mark the loading region with aria-busy on the container; skeleton itself is decorative.
Size via className/width styles to match the real component footprint — avoid layout shift when content swaps in.

agent.usage: import { Skeleton } from '@/components/atoms/Skeleton';
